title: FTSE Russell US indexes — December 2027 semi-annual reconstitution, implemented after the close of 2027-12-10 and effective at the open of 2027-12-13 (full cap-tier migration, reduced style and float scope)
source: EST: rule-derived, with the rule RE-FETCHED AND RE-EXTRACTED IN FULL BY THIS INITIAL RESEARCH rather than inherited from the proposal or from a sibling ledger. THE RULE: FTSE Russell, "Russell US Equity Indexes" construction and methodology, fetched direct 2026-09-09 via research.ftserussell.com/products/downloads/Russell-US-indexes.pdf, which 301-redirects to lseg.com/content/dam/ftse-russell/en_us/documents/ground-rules/russell-us-indexes-construction-and-methodology.pdf (HTTP 200, 746,491 bytes — BYTE-IDENTICAL to the russell-reconstitution-2026-12-11 lane's 2026-09-06 fetch, so no revision has landed; 77 content streams inflated and the text layer re-extracted in-session, version string re-read as "v7.2, August 2026"). Section 4.2.3 verbatim: "Reconstitution occurs on the fourth Friday in June and the second Friday in December. A full calendar for reconstitution is published each spring". Section 9.3.1 restates it: "third Friday in September and second Friday in December". Appendix F's schedule table gives "Implementation | 4th Friday of June | 2nd Friday of December" and defines implementation as "the day changes are made after the close of the market and become effective at the open on the Monday following". THE ARITHMETIC: December 2027's Fridays are the 3rd, 10th, 17th, 24th and 31st, so the second is Friday 2027-12-10 and the Monday following is 2027-12-13. THE DERIVATION WAS TESTED, NOT ASSERTED — the same rule reproduces the tracked December 2026 instance exactly (second Friday 2026-12-11, Monday following 2026-12-14), which FTSE Russell's July 2026 FAQ publishes independently as that quarter's Review Effective Date. Filed estimate on four counts. (1) The confirmed-tier prefixes in market-events-data.ts have no member for an index owner's own published schedule — a standing prefix gap this calendar has now recorded three times, not a source weakness. (2) This lane never self-confirms an event it discovered in-sweep. (3) NO 2027 CALENDAR EXISTS YET, VERIFIED MECHANICALLY THIS SESSION: the ground rules say the full calendar "is published each spring", and lseg.com/content/dam/ftse-russell/en_us/documents/policy-documents/ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2027.pdf returns HTTP 404 while the 2026 edition at the identical path returns HTTP 200 / 198,134 bytes. The reconstitution page's own document list, re-fetched 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 228,333 bytes), links only the 2026 FAQ and the June 2026 add/delete lists. (4) The 2026 FAQ's schedule table carries "NOTE: Dates may be subject to change. Clients will be notified of any changes." This is a standing-rule derivation, not a read of a dated table, and it cannot be upgraded before spring 2027. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH, 2026-09-09; the id previously existed only as proposals/russell-reconstitution-2027-12-10.from-russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-12-31.json, which was read in full first and stands shadowed rather than deleted. Ledger: docs/research/events/russell-reconstitution-2027-12-10.md. WHAT THIS ENTRY IS: the second-ever December Russell reconstitution, and the FIRST in complete steady state — every leg from December 2026 onward carries a six-month drift window, but June 2026 carried twelve (its predecessor was June 2025), so 2027 is the FIRST CALENDAR YEAR IN WHICH BOTH RUSSELL LEGS ARE SIX-MONTH LEGS. SCOPE, FROM THE OWNER'S OWN RULE, RE-READ THIS SESSION: Appendix F's "Reconstitution updates" table makes total market cap, nationality and total shares outstanding FULL in December, while float adjustments are "Applied with a 3% buffer" (section 9.3.3, against June's section 9.3.2 "no buffers will be observed"), style probability changes cover "New Adds to R3000E, including IPOs" plus movements between R1000/R2000/RMicro "only, not on the entire universe of securities", and voting rights are "accessed for existing members once a year during the June reconstitution process" (section 5.15.2). So the membership-migration leg lands in full and the two legs that re-weight existing holdings largely do not. THE MILESTONE CHAIN, DERIVED FROM APPENDIX F AND NOT FROM A PUBLISHED 2027 TABLE: rank day = last business day of October 2027 = Friday 2027-10-29; preliminary information released four weeks prior to implementation = Friday 2027-11-12; query period the two weeks following = 2027-11-15 to 2027-11-26 (its final week is Thanksgiving week, tracked here as thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25 and thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26); lock-down opens at the open Monday 2027-11-29 and runs the two weeks to implementation. The style capping cut-off is NOT derived — the 2026 FAQ published it as a dated cell (2026-12-02) with no rule behind it, so 2027's is unknown until the spring-2027 calendar. THE HEADLINE COLLISION, RULE-LEVEL AND PERMANENT: 2027-12-10 is a THREE-OWNER index date. Russell implements (2nd Friday, section 4.2.3); the S&P Select Sector Quarterly Qualification Date is "the second Friday of any calendar quarter-end month" per the SEC-filed Form 497 that sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-12-10 quotes; and the Nasdaq-100 annual reconstitution is announced "after the close on the sixth trading day prior to" an effective date of "the first trading day following the third Friday in December", which lands on the second Friday in all thirteen years 2020-2032 by weekday arithmetic. BUT ONLY RUSSELL TRADES THAT DAY — the other two price and announce on that close and their flow prints into the 2027-12-17 triple witching, which is why the corridor here is information-dense and flow-light. Impact medium mirrors the tracked 2026-12-11 instance; symbols is deliberately EMPTY for the reason that entry gives (an ETF proxy would make the deterministic screen trip on small-cap beta, which carries no information about reconstitution scope); kind `sector` matches the sibling market-structure flow entries because the enum has no index-flow member. Status estimate: it widens caution about the 2027-12-10 close and the 2027-12-13 open and licenses nothing.
